title: Fix 'Operation not possible due to RF-kill' error
summary: This error means the Wi-Fi card is blocked by hardware or software. Check physical switches and use rfkill to unblock.

aliases.text: operation not possible due to rf-kill

error_patterns: RTNETLINK answers: Operation not possible due to RF-kill

steps.explain: Check if the card is hard-blocked (physical switch) or soft-blocked (software).
If soft-blocked, unblock it. If hard-blocked, find and toggle the physical Wi-Fi switch on your laptop.

verify.expect: The wlan device is 'unblocked' in both SOFT and HARD columns.
